`<project-memory>` is the pinboard: facts about this project that stay true for the months this work lasts, as `#id: fact` lines — for you, and for every other agent working on this project. `ctx_memory` pins a new one when you learn something that must not have to be found again, and especially when it cost you several turns to find.
Categories for `ctx_memory`: PROJECT_RULES (a project rule), ARCHITECTURE (an architectural fact), CONSTRAINTS (a hard-won constraint), CONFIG_VALUES (a config value), NAMING (a naming convention). Examples: category="CONFIG_VALUES", content="OpenCode source is at ~/Work/OSS/opencode" · category="CONSTRAINTS", content="Dashboard Tauri build needs RGBA PNGs, not grayscale"
